desc: Use what THEY use. The Daniel Defense MK18 features the railed forend Daniel Defense currently provides to USSOCOM and a 10.3" Cold Hammer Forged Barrel. The 10.3" barrel is the same length in use for the MK18 upper most commonly used for CQB operations. The MK18 Factory SBR by Daniel Defense is unmatched in size, weight, and performance. This rifle also comes with the newly designed, rugged and comfortable Daniel Defense Buttstock and Pistol Grip.
